useful_behavior: Given a consequential, open-ended technical or scientific objective in a domain that may not be pre-mapped, autonomously decompose the problem, discover and evaluate relevant existing knowledge/tools, perform quantitative reasoning and computation, revise the plan when evidence falsifies assumptions, synthesize evidence across sources and modalities, independently verify consequential claims, and deliver a decision-quality real-world result while preserving provenance and reusable capability.

evidence.source: OpenAI — GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
observed_capabilities: complex work across knowledge work and science
write/run lightweight programs that coordinate tools, process intermediate results, monitor progress, and choose next action

evidence.source: OpenAI Help — Deep research in ChatGPT
observed_capabilities: combine and analyze information from multiple sources
produce structured reports with citations/source links
allow iterative refinement as evidence changes

frontier_reference.frontier_bar: Brain must reproduce the useful end-to-end behavior on real consequential work without depending on the frontier implementation, with independent verification and provenance. A narrow deterministic domain calculator is insufficient.

minimum_acquisition_evidence.real_task_A: One difficult real technical/scientific task completed end-to-end with documented search/reuse, quantitative analysis, falsification, tool use where useful, and independent verification.
minimum_acquisition_evidence.real_task_B: One materially different real task in a different technical/scientific domain completed using the inherited route without rediscovering the operating method.

evidence_B.requirement: Materially different real technical/scientific domain; must reuse the general research/problem-solving route, not merely rerun the launch calculator.

residual_gap: Cross-domain transfer and frontier-equivalent end-to-end autonomy remain unproven.
